name: Campingplatz Hager
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Hager is located in Langkampfen in the Lower Inntal valley, just a few kilometres from the fortress town of Kufstein. Framed by the Kaisergebirge and Brandenberg Alps, it features generous pitches with electricity, modern sanitary facilities, and a guest lounge. Fresh bread delivery and a cosy inn serving regional cuisine complete the offer. Walking and cycle routes begin right at the park, with a children's playground and sunbathing lawn welcoming families.
